column1: # Categories in the publication simulation set: the ONE table mapping the
# internal category letter to everything that varies with it.
# The letters are the historical scheme (README_snakemake.md, "List of
# simulations"). They are kept because they are the bridge to everything that
# already reads them -- summarize_coloc.DEMOGRAPHY, the notebook's
# CATEGORY_LABEL/color_key, the seed convention -- but they are NOT what the
# published directories are named. `dir_name` is.
# Why a table rather than four copies of a bash `case`: the four round-3
# launchers each carry their own copy of these tables and have already drifted
# (only submit_2Mb_r3_cmaf_fm001.sh knows K and L; submit_2Mb_r3_cmaf01_control.sh
# has no category_extra at all). helpers/tests/test_launcher_tables.py asserts
# they agree where they overlap; this file is how the publication launcher avoids
# becoming a fifth copy.
# Columns
#   letter        internal category id
#   dir_name      the published directory name
#   species       human | cattle
#   pipeline      which stage-1 rule file runs (config["pipeline"])
#   config        config YAML, with ${CELL} interpolated by the launcher
#   seed_prefix   stage1_seed / stage2_seed = <seed_prefix><replicate>. A category
#                 with a donor MUST repeat the donor's prefix, and the launcher
#                 refuses to run if it does not: stage-1 lookup is seed-strict, so
#                 a mismatch would not adopt the donor's file, it would silently
#                 start a fresh multi-hour genetic simulation instead.
#   stage1_donor  the category whose stage-1 tree sequence this one ADOPTS, or
#                 "self" to use its own. A donor means this category never runs
#                 stage 1.
#   extra_config  --config tokens that distinguish this category from the one its
#                 config file belongs to. LOAD-BEARING for K and L: they use A's
#                 and E's configs, and are only different simulations because of
#                 this column. NO TOKEN MAY CONTAIN A SPACE (the launcher expands
#                 it unquoted so each token becomes its own --config argument).
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# K and L adopt A's and E's genomes deliberately, the way O<-A and P<-E already
# do. K is A's genome with the causal loci drawn from the strictly NEUTRAL
# variants and their effects drawn from the truncated DFE, so pairing them to the
# same tree sequence at the same seed is what makes A-K isolate the effect
# assignment with the genealogy held literally fixed. Run at their own seed bands
# (11N/12N, as the preliminary K/L runs were) that contrast also carries
# replicate noise.
letter
A
E
K
L
F
G
